title: Persistent map updates
summary: Build an immutable map of 200 to 1,000 string keys, apply 100 to 500 sets and deletes each making a new version, and read keys in the first, middle and last versions.
notes: Some entries share structure between versions (hash tries, a radix tree) and some copy the whole map on every update (frozendict, immutabledict, Immer and the standard-library copies), so the same job is different work; the figures include that difference.
